content:
ashok: FYI — started seeing a wave of new nodes stuck in provisioning after the 552 driver rollout in us-east2. Several never come up past cloud-init.

maria: Confirmed. ~8 of 120 in gpu-pool-4 are failing. Logs show `modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-1063`

kevin: Are those dedicated or autoscaling machines? did the canary pass?

ashok: Dedicated (reserved). Canary passed (2 nodes), rollout hit 30% and then these started failing. Upgrade kicked off at 02:12 UTC.

maria: Pulled the DKMS build log from one failing host:
```
make -C /lib/modules/5.15.0-1063/build M=/var/lib/dkms/nvidia/552/build 
...
ERROR: modversions: symbol mismatch for 'nvidia_register_gpu'
modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-1063
```

dana: We also have running jobs reporting NCCL issues on some nodes that did come up: 
`NCCL WARN Call to ibv_create_srq failed` then hangs on multi-GPU training. Might be IB/driver ABI mismatch.

kevin: Is this kernel-version specific? any difference between 5.15.x on affected vs unaffected?

maria: Looks like all failing ones are on 5.15.0-1063-aws (packaged by our cloud image). eu-west nodes on 5.15.0-1059 are fine. Could be a header mismatch between kernel-headers and the running image.

ashok: I've paused the rollout at 33% and tainted remaining nodes in the pool so k8s won't schedule GPU jobs on them. Also put a routing override for ephemeral jobs to prefer eu-west for now. Rolling back a subset to 550 on the first 6 failing nodes.

deploy-bot: Deployment halted by user `ashok` at 1812349999. Rollout state: PAUSED. Taint applied to 33 nodes.

kevin: Good call. For remediation:
1) Stop further rollout.
2) For failing hosts, try installing prebuilt `.ko` from a healthy host and reboot as temporary fix.
3) Rebuild DKMS packages against exact kernel headers in a staging image before reattempting.
4) Contact Nvidia support if ABI mismatch persists.

maria: I SSH'd into one of the stuck nodes and copied /lib/modules/5.15.0-1059/nvidia/*.ko from a healthy eu-west node into the failing 5.15.0-1063 path, updated depmod, rebooted. Node came up but NCCL still flaky. Not a safe long-term solution.

ashok: Rolling back 552->550 on 6 impacted nodes completed. Those nodes rejoined and jobs drained off flaky ones. We still have ~2 nodes failing build completely.

dana: I'll own the postmortem. Plan to gather: DKMS build logs, kernel and header packages, timestamps of deploy, affected node IDs, NCCL logs, and job IDs. Will escalate to Nvidia rep if we can reproduce ABI mismatch. ETA 2h.

kevin: Also let's add an automated preflight: build DKMS for new kernel versions in a CI matrix before pushing driver images. And add a canary that includes a scaled-up canary (5 nodes) across the actual kernel variants we run.

maria: Filing infra ticket `INFRA-2379` with logs and list of affected nodes. Will attach `dmesg` and `dkms status --verbose`.

ashok: Quick commands I ran for visibility:
```bash
# find failing dkms build
ssh node-ixx
sudo journalctl -u dkms --since "2026-03-18 02:00"
# check module dir
ls -la /lib/modules/5.15.0-1063 | grep nvidia
# temp copy (not recommended long-term)
sudo scp root@healthy:/lib/modules/5.15.0-1059/nvidia/*.ko /lib/modules/5.15.0-1063/nvidia/; sudo depmod -a; sudo reboot
```

dana: I'll also validate our DKMS packaging step in the builder image—the kernel-headers package might be versioned differently in the `-aws` builds which would explain symbols mismatch.

kevin: Note for runbook: if nodes are stuck in initramfs because modprobe stalls, we should have an automated fallback to reimage to the previous AMI instead of retrying the same DKMS build repeatedly.

maria: One more datapoint — ap-south cluster is untouched (different kernel family). Seems localized to the 5.15.0-1063 AWS kernel line.

dana: I'll collect kernel config and the exact gcc versions used to build headers vs our DKMS build. Might be a subtle toolchain ABI issue.

ashok: Thanks all. For now, rollback complete for the majority, taints in place, and postmortem + infra ticket open. Keep channel updated if you see any more failures.

kevin: :thumbsup: And let's add a follow-up check to Redwood Console to flag high DKMS failure rate as an alert condition (ops-runbooks).

sre-bot: Alert muted for `dkms-build-failure` in us-east2 for 30m (user request: ashok).

maria: I'll attach the two failing host logs to the ticket and link here when done.
